title: EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance
abstract: arXiv:2609.40230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model's parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases \textit{perception under insufficient evidence} and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual querie

translated_title: EviRover：超越一瞥的强化智能体式感知
translated_abstract: 视觉感知通常被表述为对图像一瞥后的单次预测，其前提假设是图像内容与模型的参数化知识足以解决查询。这一假设在依赖细粒度视觉细节、或需要知识密集型与最新信息的真实场景中常常失效。我们将此类情况称为“证据不足下的感知”，并将感知重新表述为一个智能体过程，使其能够获取一瞥之外的信息。为解决这一设置下数据缺失的问题，我们设计了两个专门的数据生成流水线，生成了用于训练的EviRover-SFT-5K和EviRover-RL-12K数据集。我们进一步构建了EviLens，一个经过人工验证的基准，涵盖五个感知类别共688个实例。基于这些数据，我们提出了EviRover——据我们所知，这是首个被明确训练用于解决感知查询的感知智能体。
tldr: 提出EviRover——首个针对“证据不足下的感知”明确训练的视觉感知智能体，能够主动获取一瞥之外的证据来应对细粒度与知识密集型的感知查询，并配套设计了专用训练数据流水线和人工验证的EviLens基准。
en_tdlr: EviRover is, to our knowledge, the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve queries under insufficient evidence by actively gathering information beyond a single glance, supported by dedicated data generation pipelines and the human-verified EviLens benchmark.
